decisions.evidence: r4 maker: open prototype, 'paste any complete web address, click Get details' preview. r4 client reports preview showed only 'the site name, a title, and a description' and requests 'the little site icon and, if the page has one, a thumbnail image.' r5 maker adds 'site icon beside the site name and the page thumbnail.'
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Presented auto-collect fell short of REF-BM-02 (favicon + preview image omitted); client supplies the reference-conforming completion. Corrective/correct.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker presents a preview-before-save step. r4 client: 'Before I hit Save, I'd want to be able to tweak the title and the description myself, right there — not be stuck with exactly what came back.' r5 maker adds direct in-preview editing.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Edit-before-save (REF-BM-03) absent from presented preview scope; client requests the missing reference requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r8 maker specification gate: 'do all the saving behaviors we've checked so far ... match your intent?' r8 client: 'what happens if I try to save a link I've already saved before? ... I'd expect it to notice it's already there and just take me to the one I already have ... rather than creating a duplicate.' r9 maker builds duplicate flow.
decisions.note: Specification-gate stage. Duplicate handling (REF-BM-06) omitted from the saving scope presented as complete; client requests the missing reference requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r11 maker: 'search ... looks through saved titles and descriptions.' r11 client: 'I also keep notes and the web addresses ... so eventually I'd want a search to look through those too, not just the title and description.' r12-r13 maker adds note and url matching.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Presented search covered only title/description, short of REF-BM-12 (title, description, note, url); client extends to the full field coverage. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r17 maker specification gate covers only tag filtering. r17 client: 'how tags get onto a bookmark in the first place ... I'd want to put one or more tags on it myself, and as I type a tag I'd love it to suggest ones I've already used so I don't end up with recipe and recipes.' r18 maker builds tag entry + suggestions.
decisions.note: Specification-gate stage. Tag assignment (REF-BM-09) and autocomplete (REF-BM-10) absent from presented tag scope; client requests both missing reference requirements in one coherent ask. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r29 maker presents plain note entry in the save flow. r29 client: 'if I bother to format it a bit, like a couple of bullet points or a bold word, I'd want that to come through rather than just showing as plain typed characters.' r30-r32 maker adds markdown formatting/rendering.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Markdown note rendering (REF-BM-23) absent from presented note scope; client requests the missing reference requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r37 maker presents archive/restore (reversible). r37 client: 'I'd also want a separate way to actually delete a bookmark for good ... because that one can't be undone, that's the case where I'd expect it to ask me to confirm first.' r38+ maker builds permanent delete with confirmation.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Permanent delete (REF-BM-05) and its distinction from reversible archive (REF-BM-27) absent from presented scope; client requests both. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r55 maker declares 'nine feature flows are settled ... May I start implementing this scope?' r55 client: 'we never confirmed the most basic thing ... When I spot a saved bookmark ... and click it, I'd expect it to actually take me to the original webpage.' r56 maker builds title-as-link opening.
decisions.note: Specification-gate stage. Opening the original url (REF-BM-08) omitted from the scope presented as complete; client requests the missing reference requirement. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r55 maker presents scope as complete. r55 client: 'Being able to put my list in an order that helps me — like newest first, or by title — rather than being stuck with one fixed arrangement.' r58-r61 maker builds ordering.
decisions.note: Specification-gate stage. Sort by key (REF-BM-22) omitted from the scope presented as complete; client requests it. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r55 maker presents scope as complete. r55 client: 'being able to pick several bookmarks at once and do the same thing to all of them — say, tag them together, or archive a batch — instead of clicking through them one at a time.' r62 maker builds multi-selection.
decisions.note: Specification-gate stage. Multi-select bulk actions (REF-BM-20) omitted from the scope presented as complete; client requests it. Corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: r62 maker presents a batch-action bar offering only 'Add tags and Archive selected.' r62 client: 'I'd also expect to be able to do the other group things to a batch, like marking them read-later (or done) and deleting a selection ... the batch actions to eventually cover that same tidy-up range.' r64-r70 maker builds the fuller range.
decisions.note: Prototype-review stage. Same requirement (REF-BM-20) at a later point: presented bulk actions were a subset of the reference bulk action range; client extends to request the missing actions. Corrective/extend, counted separately from the r55 scope-gate decision.

decisions.evidence: r72 maker: 'May I switch to development and implement this approved scope?'; r73 delivery accepted. r73 client: 'down the line I might like a couple of extra conveniences like saving a favorite search as a reusable view ... Please just jot those down for later — they're not part of what we agreed this time, and I'm happy with what you've delivered.'
decisions.note: Implementation-review/delivery stage. Bundle / saved-filter (REF-BM-29) omitted from delivered scope; client explicitly identifies the feature and accepts the departure (defers to a future round) without requesting alignment. Accepted divergence.

decisions.evidence: r73 client: '... and bringing bookmarks in from or out to my browser. Please just jot those down for later — they're not part of what we agreed this time, and I'm happy with what you've delivered.'
decisions.note: Delivery stage. Import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31) omitted from delivered scope; client explicitly names the in/out feature and accepts the departure as future work. Accepted divergence (one coherent ask covering both items).

decisions.evidence: Search demonstrated only as substring across fields (r11-r13). r13 client: 'search is now reaching the title, description, my note, and the address — which is the full sweep I wanted. This part's solid.' r55/r72 scope declared complete; #tag search-syntax never presented or requested.
decisions.note: Specification-gate/prototype-review. #tag search syntax (REF-BM-14) omitted from a search area the client affirmed as the 'full sweep'; the divergence passed with no corrective response or expression of the difference. Unexpressed divergence (approval alone; noticing not inferable).

decisions.evidence: Boolean/parenthesised search operators (with the literal-quoting rule) never presented across r11-r13; r13 client declares search 'the full sweep I wanted'; r55/r72 scope declared complete without the client raising operators.
decisions.note: REF-BM-15 (AND/OR/NOT + groups) omitted from the settled search scope; no corrective response or explicit expression of the difference. Unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: Quoted-phrase exact-match search never presented (r11-r13); client affirmed search complete at r13 and approved full scope at r72 without raising phrase search.
decisions.note: REF-BM-16 (quoted-phrase exact match) omitted from the settled search scope; passed without corrective response or expression of the difference. Unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: r72 maker: 'implement this approved scope'; r73 maker delivery lists all covered areas, no snapshot. r73 client accepts as complete and raises only bundles + import/export as future, not snapshots.
decisions.note: Delivery stage. Local HTML/PDF snapshot (REF-BM-24) omitted from the scope presented and accepted as complete; client did not surface it while surfacing other extended items. Unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: Internet Archive snapshot never presented anywhere; r72 scope declared complete, r73 accepted as complete without the client raising it.
decisions.note: REF-BM-25 omitted from the accepted scope; passed with no corrective response or expression of the difference. Unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: Ordering was demonstrated (r58-r61) but no user-settings surface (default-sort preference, displayed-items count, font size) was ever presented; r72 scope declared complete and r73 accepted without the client raising display settings.
decisions.note: REF-BM-32 (display-related personal settings) omitted from the accepted scope; passed without corrective response or expression of the difference. Unexpressed divergence.

decisions.evidence: r4 maker: prominent address box, paste url, Get details; r4 client saves via url. Conforms.
decisions.note: Prototype-review. Save-by-url conforms to reference. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r9-r10: re-saving an existing url opens the existing bookmark in edit mode with Update; tags (r18-22) and notes (r29-32) editable. Conforms to editing url/title/desc/tags/note.
decisions.note: Editing existing bookmark fields conforms to REF-BM-04. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r11-r12 card layout exposing title, description, tags, favicon, note, address; r11 client: 'the card layout makes it easy to see what's left after filtering.' Conforms.
decisions.note: Readability-first list with required per-item fields conforms to REF-BM-07. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r14-r16: clicking a tag narrows the library; combines with text search. Conforms to filter-by-tag.
decisions.note: Tag filtering conforms to REF-BM-11 (A/B sidebar-vs-top choice is functionally equivalent, excluded). Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r11 client types 'PASTA' uppercase and matches the pasta recipe; r11 maker confirms case handling. Conforms.
decisions.note: Case-insensitive search conforms to REF-BM-13. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r24 maker: 'Read later' control on a card flips to 'Saved for later'; client confirms marked state. Conforms.
decisions.note: Read-later marking conforms to REF-BM-17. Not divergent (heart-vs-label A/B equivalent, excluded).

decisions.evidence: r26: sidebar 'Read later' view shows only marked bookmarks; client confirms. Conforms.
decisions.note: Dedicated unread view conforms to REF-BM-18. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r27 unmarking removes from Read later view; r66 batch 'Mark done' removes from the list while keeping bookmarks in library. Conforms.
decisions.note: Marking read removes from unread list conforms to REF-BM-19. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r34-r36: archiving removes a bookmark from the main library while preserving content; client confirms 'it dropped straight out of the main library.' Conforms.
decisions.note: Archive hides from default list while keeping content, conforms to REF-BM-26. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r36 sidebar Archive view shows only archived bookmarks with details intact; active bookmarks excluded. Conforms.
decisions.note: Separate archived list conforms to REF-BM-28. Not divergent.

decisions.evidence: r66 maker: 'select all bookmarks currently shown' in the filtered Read later view, then apply a batch action to that filtered scope; edge rule limits bulk to the current filter's scope. Client confirms the batch acted on the shown set.
decisions.note: Applying a bulk action to the current filtered scope is realized equivalently via select-all-shown; treated as conforming to REF-BM-21 rather than a confirmed divergence given the ambiguous evidence. Not divergent.
